name: Sedlmayr Grund und Immobilien AG
summary: Sedlmayr Grund und Immobilien AG engages in the acquisition, management, and sale of land and other properties in Germany. The company owns a portfolio of residential and commercial buildings in Munich and Stuttgart. It rents residential properties, garages/parking places, commercial properties, and prospective tenants. The company was formerly known as Sedlmayr Grund und Immobilien KGaA and changed its name to Sedlmayr Grund und Immobilien AG in October 2018. Sedlmayr Grund und Immobilien AG was founded in 1397 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany. Sedlmayr Grund und Immobilien AG is a subsidiary of Sedlmayr Treuhand GmbH.
